---
title: "Dashboards & Outputs"
---

The SupplyLens dashboard is a single HTML file (`docs/dashboard.html`) with 30 tabs, all reading from the same sample data derived from the Scania supply chain graph. Each tab is either inline in `dashboard.html` or a linked standalone HTML file in the `docs/` directory. One additional standalone file provides a 3D graph view.

Open the dashboard:

```bash
xdg-open docs/dashboard.html
# or navigate to the docs/ directory and open dashboard.html in browser
```

---

## Source Code

Python modules in `src/` implement the pipeline logic and analytical models. Each module is independently importable and can be run as a CLI tool.

| File | What it does |
|------|--------------|
| src/agent.py | LangGraph pipeline: scrape → extract → kotaemon_rag → embed → infer → compliance_check → merge |
| src/neo4j_client.py | Cypher query wrapper with connection pooling |
| src/kotaemon_client.py | Kotaemon RAG client with circuit breaker and fact sheet builder |
| src/risk_scorer.py | Risk flag to score logic |
| src/cbam_calculator.py | CBAM carbon border tax liability per supplier |
| src/alternative_sourcing.py | Alternative supplier scorer; outputs SWITCH_NOW / DUAL_SOURCE recommendations |
| src/disruption_model.py | Disruption scenarios with revenue-at-risk calculation |
| src/resilience_scorer.py | 6-dimensional HHI resilience scoring |
| src/scenario_modeler.py | 7 named scenarios with best / base / worst outcomes |
| src/supply_chain_simulator.py | Monte Carlo simulation — 10,000 trials, P10 / P50 / P90 output |
| src/graph_analyzer.py | Degree, betweenness, HHI, bottleneck detection, longest-path |
| src/sanctions_screener.py | Fuzzy name screening against OFAC / EU / UN sanctions lists |
| src/procurement_report.py | HTML procurement report generator per SKU |
| src/postgres_sync.py | Syncs Neo4j supplier nodes to PostgreSQL `knopenkonings.suppliers` |

Additional scripts and data files:

| File | What it does |
|------|--------------|
| example_outputs/sample_graph.cypher | v10: 2,305 lines; 17 events; Scania autonomous truck AI chain (NVIDIA / TSMC / ASML / JSR) |
| scripts/ingest_kotaemon.py | Bulk ingest supplier documents into Kotaemon CT120 |
| scripts/seed_scania.sh | Load Cypher into Neo4j CT114 |
| config/n8n_workflow.json | 14-node n8n weekly refresh workflow definition |
